criteria.final_justification: Keep baseline 1/4. DOM supports only one required filter (4 Stars & Up). Prime-eligible and price-below-$40 filters are not evidenced as applied, and sorting is still `Featured` (not Avg. Customer Review). The agent’s failure to complete the required filters/sort is therefore confirmed rather than excused by an uncontrollable platform blocker (no CAPTCHA/login wall is shown).

Keep baseline 0/3. Although DOM contains enough data to report a top product on the page, the agent did not output any product record, and the required filter/sort setup is not achieved/verified. No uncontrollable blocker is evidenced that would justify full credit for downstream reporting.

Keep baseline 0/3. Agent did not report a second product. Additionally, the visible #2 item in DOM violates the <$40 constraint and the required sort/filter state is not met, so there is no supported way to treat it as the requested rank #2 under the required conditions.

Keep baseline 0/3. The agent did not report a third product record. Even aside from that, the required filter/sort state is not evidenced, and the DOM excerpt for the third item is incomplete for the required fields (price and review count) within the captured evidence.

Keep baseline 2/2. The constraints (no sign-in, no add to cart, no purchase) are supported by DOM and action history. Stopping early is consistent with avoiding fabrication, even though the task deliverables were not met (that shortfall is scored in other criteria).
